hazards.reason: The projection view report.order_summary publishes (code VARCHAR(80), total BIGINT, customer_name VARCHAR(80)) and now publishes (code VARCHAR(80), total BIGINT, customer_name VARCHAR(80), placed_at TIMESTAMPTZ): its readers' Arrow schema changes.
hazards.subject: view/report.order_summary

statements:
CREATE VIEW report.order_summary WITH (security_barrier = true) AS
-- Projection column order is the published Arrow contract.
SELECT -- noqa: ST06
  base.code,
  base.total,
  customer."name" AS customer_name,
  base.placed_at
FROM "order" AS base
  INNER JOIN customer AS customer ON base.customer_id = customer.id
COMMENT ON VIEW report.order_summary IS 'Orders with their customer''s name, for reporting.'
